headline: HOMEBODY's lot finally grows — a Spare Room for §300 (merge pending green nightly)
lede: The oldest gap on HOMEBODY's honest list — one fixed lot, forever — got a hammer this session: buy the Spare Room card and the east lawn becomes a plank-floored wing with punched doorway, windows and wallpaper. The whole connectivity law sees it the tick it's built, because every walker and guard now asks one honest ground question. The stage is green on every gate and waits only on the merge-freeze clearing after QA's main fix.

notes.text: Spare Room kit (catalog card 14 / R in buy mode, §300, one per lot): 12 floor cells, brick-band walls, a door into the shared wall, two east windows, wallpaper strip, hammer-knock SFX, and the attract page tells you — closes honest-gaps #0 via PR #1809 (#1806).

Honesty by inheritance: the wing is a state overlay (s.ext) and groundOf(s,r,c) became THE ground question for solidAt/walkable/canPlace/keepsOpen/BFS/manual/bot — so residents, the gate, and every furniture use-spot provably stay connected, the room-side door cell refuses furniture once the room is lived-in, and ext rides the state hash.

peoplecheck 59/59 with two source pins and a mutant (strip groundOf from solidAt -> exactly the wing gates go red); homebodydrive 22/22 in real Chrome including pixel proof of glass and planks — plus the drive's pre-existing Escape-pause flake is fixed. Merge sat behind the #601 freeze: QA already fixed main's red nightly (#1807) and the replacement nightly is queued; next slot-a merges when it lands green.
